context: Headline weighted natural implementation: second-lowest without-context baseline in the all-eval run; Java 24 blocking per-element remote checks with a per-operation service concurrency limit should use a bounded stream concurrency shape rather than parallelStream or unbounded async work.

checklist.name: Creates coherent Java 24 artifact
checklist.description: Creates FavoriteProducts.java with the requested method, nested types, imports, and Java 24-compatible code.

checklist.name: Preserves favorite product behavior
checklist.description: Returns only products whose sku passes InventoryApi.check and sorts the final returned products by Product::name.

checklist.name: Uses bounded Gatherers.mapConcurrent
checklist.description: Uses Gatherers.mapConcurrent with an explicit max concurrency no greater than 8 to perform the blocking InventoryApi.check calls inside the stream pipeline.

checklist.name: Carries product with stock result
checklist.description: Keeps each Product associated with its stock-check result, for example with Map.entry(product, InventoryApi.check(product.sku())), then filters by the boolean result before mapping back to Product.

checklist.name: Rejects weak concurrency choices
checklist.description: Does not use parallelStream(), .parallel(), unbounded CompletableFuture fan-out, or shared mutable state for collecting remote check results.

checklist.name: Keeps implementation focused
checklist.description: Avoids unrelated caching, retries, dependencies, API redesign, or broad concurrency framework changes.

metadata.headline_selection: selected from all-26 Sonnet 4.6 run because at least one without-context criterion scored below 50%
